name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 V4 beta.2
readme:
## Open services

- **Page** — Port `3000`
- **Claude MCP** — Port `3001` (public HTTPS proxy, secret access-code path, no IP lock)
- **ComfyUI** — Port `8188`
- **JupyterLab** — Port `8888`

Kendo MiniMax H3 V4 beta.2 keeps the stable V3 Fast mode and adds an optional High Resolution dual-pass pipeline. High Resolution generates a 0.4–0.7 MP base latent, preserves its audio branch, upscales only the video latent by 1.5x or 2x with the pinned H3 3D neural upscaler, then refines the low-sigma tail before decoding. Optional Realism People and Facial Detail LoRAs are available. Fast remains the default. The Page supports 9 images / 1 video / 3 audio references, seed lock, queue status, prompt-free history, Comfy log and Claude MCP. First launch downloads both INT8 diffusion models plus the shared encoder, VAEs, Turbo/quality LoRAs and the 691 MB latent upscaler (about 66 GB total) with resume support. High Resolution saves time versus native full-resolution generation but does not reduce peak VRAM; RTX PRO 6000 96 GB is recommended for long 2x jobs. V3, V2 and existing V4 templates remain separate.
